simple.meaning: מַתָּן (Mattân) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with priesthood. The surrounding account also brings the name into death.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Jeremiah, beginning at 2 Kings 11:18. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, altar, death, priesthood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַתָּן (H4977) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מַתָּן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: מַתָּן (Mattân) / H4977 is tracked through 2 Kings 11:18, 2 Chronicles 23:17, Jeremiah 38:1. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over Yahweh’s house.
